entries.0727349fa9473198: This category covers receipt of patent royalties and other income; revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥173,178 million (¥156,107 million in the previous year, up 10.9% year on year). Royalty income is received from Bristol Myers Squibb, Merck, Roche and others, relating to "Opdivo Intravenous Infusion" and to patents on anti-PD-1/PD-L1 antibodies. The company expects this income to decline in stages in the future, due to changes in royalty rates and patent expiries in various countries.

entries.4ad61bb91d9c68ee: This category covers sales of the company's own pharmaceutical products in Japan and overseas; revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥342,607 million (¥330,763 million in the previous year). Domestic product sales were ¥281.4 billion (down 3.5% year on year), of which "Opdivo Intravenous Infusion" accounted for ¥114.3 billion (down 5.0%) and "Forxiga Tablets", after generic products entered the market in December 2025, accounted for ¥88.2 billion (down 1.5%). Overseas product sales were ¥61.2 billion (up 56.5% year on year), of which "Qinlock", sold by Deciphera, accounted for ¥38.4 billion and "Romvimza" for ¥8.3 billion. Deciphera's sales cover nine months after the acquisition (July to March) in the previous fiscal year and 12 months in the current year.

entries.8bcae692a1243693: A pharmaceutical company that researches, develops and sells prescription drugs in Japan and overseas, focusing on the areas of cancer, immunology, inflammation and neurology.
entries.b6ca02091075ef63: This is a single business covering the whole company, engaged in the research and development, procurement, manufacturing and sale of prescription drugs and over-the-counter drugs. Within this, prescription drugs are the core area in which the company places particular emphasis on research and development, with oncology, immunology and inflammation, and neurology as its priority areas. As of March 31, 2026, the company and 28 subsidiaries conducted this business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥515.8 billion (up 5.9% year on year). In Japan, the company sells products including the cancer treatment "Opdivo", and overseas, Deciphera, a US company acquired in 2024, sells products including the gastrointestinal stromal tumor treatment "Qinlock". Because the reportable segment is a single segment, figures are not broken down by segment.
